name: claude-animated-shorts-paperbag
description: Stickman Paperbag 3D Animated Shorts (Remotion + Three.js + Python Audio DSP)

scripts.render:video: npx remotion render src/index.ts BridgeShort out/video_silent.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.mux: ffmpeg -y -i out/video_silent.mp4 -i templates/audio/mix.wav -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -shortest out/final_paperbag_short.mp4
scripts.build:all: npm run voice && npm run audio && npm run render:video && npm run mux
